podcast.body: Released on November 23rd, 2004, more than 10 years after Kurt Cobain's death, this highly anticipated 4-CD box set compiled "what was left of the Nirvana legacy." It contained "some pretty raw stuff" from the band's history, dating back to 1987, and was released just in time for Christmas. "One of the most anticipated box sets in the history of music was with the lights out, a 4 CD set featuring what was left of the Nirvana legacy."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.body: The Nirvana box set "With The Lights Out" includes the song "Merrigold," which is Dave Grohl's only contribution to the official Nirvana canon. This track was originally from Grohl's pre-Nirvana project, Late, and recorded before he joined the band. "If you have the CD single for Heart Shape Box, or the Nirvana Box set with the lights out, you may know of a song called Merrigold."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.body: This box set later included "Mera Gold," a song written and sung by Dave Grohl. Its inclusion provided wider access to a track that had originally been "buried" as the last song on the "Heart-Shaped Box" CD single. "It was later issued as part of the box that called with the lights out."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
